title: Chemiluminescence Detection of ROS Production in Tomato
author: Parvinderdeep S Kahlon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beeejbbe

steps.title: Prepare leaf discs
steps.instruction: Create leaf discs and incubate them in MOPS buffer overnight.

substeps.instruction: Make 8 leaf discs per genotype using a biopsy punch.
Incubate discs in 200µl of 20mM MOPS in a 96-well plate overnight.

steps.title: Apply HRP mix
steps.instruction: Replace the incubation buffer with HRP mix.

substeps.instruction: Remove the MOPS buffer the next day.
Add 75µl of HRP mix to each well.

steps.title: Establish luminescence baseline
steps.instruction: Measure initial luminescence to adjust the baseline.

substeps.instruction: Read the plate in a luminometer at 1-5 minute intervals for the initial 10 minutes.

steps.title: Apply elicitor or control
steps.instruction: Treat the leaf discs with either the desired elicitor or a negative control.

substeps.instruction: Add 25µl of 4X concentration of the desired elicitor (e.g., flg22) to 4 wells per genotype.
Add 25µl of water or the solution used for dissolving the elicitor to another 4 wells per genotype as a negative control.
Read the plate in 1-5 minute intervals for 60-180 minutes.

steps.title: Normalize data
steps.instruction: Process the luminescence data for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Normalize data to the average of the initial 5-10 minute reads (pre-elicitation).
Normalize the resulting values to the negative control.
